mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, c.content, c.create_time AS createTime FROM forum_comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
